reviews.title: Best Case Around
reviews.comment: I've built into this case at least half a dozen times, and I've made builds for other people in it as well. If you want a minimalist case that can fit large components without compromise, this case is nearly perfect. It's not flashy, but it's far smaller and more durable than most big, ugly cases with glass on them, which waste tons of space.
reviews.author: Nicholas

reviews.title: Versatile ITX Case
reviews.comment:
This case is EXACTLY what you want in a mini ITX case. Breathable, flexible mesh panels (which can bend easily if you aren't careful. If you have OCD, I suggest you take your time with taking the side panels off and on). This case comes with a multitude of configurations, from a ATX, matx, ITX motherboard fit to a SF, SF-L and ATX PSU configurations.
The shipping does come with an instruction manual with all these possible configuration ideas if not more.
Pro: This case is multifunctional. Meaning, it has a huge customizable option depending on what exactly you want.
If you do your research before buying, this case can be a replacement for those huge bulky chassis that most people think you need. YOUTUBE is also a major help when it comes to needing videos outside of pictures as to what the case can and cannot do.
CON: the only con I have about the case is, ALL THE SCREWS ARE TINY. I mean EXTREMELY small. So having magnetized tools can make building easy. Also, if you have big hands, cable management might be an issue but not impossible, as most small ITX cases because of the lack of space.
Overall its a really good case especially for a first time builder like myself who wanted a small but not too compact gaming PC for streaming. It definitely fit everything I wanted but again, thats because I did my research and googled everything I wanted in it BEFORE I purchased it.
